title: The Shared Handi
prompt: Create an original professional illustration-led logo for a contemporary biryani brand named exactly DUM E ODISHA. Pure clean flat graphic logo artwork on warm ivory #FFF7E8. The SYMBOL is the hero, 65% of artwork area: a compact generous round terracotta handi cooking pot cradled by two simplified welcoming human figures, one on each side, their inward curved arms becoming the handles of the pot, a rising single rice-panicle sprig as aromatic steam in the centre. Very simple abstract elongated people, clear round heads, flowing solid body shapes, no facial features, no costume, no triangles joined at waist, no chef hats. An original contemporary illustration evoking communal meal-making and Odisha rural visual storytelling, NOT a reproduction of any ritual tribal painting. Use bold silhouette and intelligent negative space as in the supplied reference's simplicity, but wholly different original composition. 3 flat solid colours only: earthy red #A23D32, forest green #254C3B, small warm ochre #D6A64D, cream ground. Icon broadly round and immediately reads as two people sharing a pot, not a corporate handshake or generic bowl. Tasteful small hand-lettered sturdy sans name underneath on 2 lines: 'DUM E' with clearly visible spaces around E, then 'ODISHA'. No other text. No ornamental frame, no mandala, no deities, no temple, no generic exotic tribal costumes, no gradients, no texture, no mockup. Excellent sophisticated custom symbol craft, broad shapes, minimal small detail, contemporary Indian food-brand warmth. Square canvas, beautiful whitespace.

title: The Dum Garden
prompt: Design one original premium illustrative LOGO for authentic biryani brand DUM E ODISHA, clean flat vector-like colour graphic on ivory #FFF6E7. Large hero symbol, small supporting brand name. Meaningful concept: a generous lidded handi pot becomes a garden of aroma: two elegant symmetrical flowering stems rise naturally from the pot's two shoulders and curve inward to form an open scalloped garden niche above the lid; central steam is three elongated rice grains. Mughal botanical illustration inspired in its rhythmic balanced flower-and-leaf silhouette, interpreted in sophisticated modern flat graphic language, not a historical copy, not a religious arch, not a mosque, no crescent, no crown, no royal man, no palace. Wide pot has one simple negative-space layered-rice band, large clear silhouette. Controlled 3-colour artwork: deep aubergine #4D2445 for pot and lettering, muted coral #CE6B4F for one flower, ochre #D3A749 for rice accents and a few leaves, cream negative space. Only 2 blossoms total and 4 leaves each side, bold large shapes not ornate tiny details. Beautiful icon occupies 65% of composition. Name beneath on two lines, exact 'DUM E' with true spaces around E then 'ODISHA', substantial graceful softly flared custom capitals, readable. No tagline or extra writing. Reference image conveys simple meaningful graphic symbolism only: do not copy its animal. No gradient, gold foil, shading, photograph, mockup or bevel. Distinctive designed restaurant icon.

title: The Dum Keeper
prompt: Create an original modern ILLUSTRATIVE SYMBOL LOGO for biryani brand DUM E ODISHA. Follow supplied chef reference only for clever negative-space simplicity, NEVER copy its silhouette, moustache, hat or arrangement. Hero icon: a warm smiling cook/host shown in three-quarter upper body, with simple short swept hair (no toque, no turban), one curved arm extending to cradle a round handi pot at chest level. The pot is unmistakably the main gesture: an ivory negative-space opening with three visible saffron rice grains and one bold curved aroma rising toward the host's face. The face profile and steam share one carefully designed negative-space curve suggesting smelling the biryani. Apron below in a single bold shape, one simple leaf/clove detail. Human portrait is friendly gender-neutral without caricature. Strong professional compact emblem, not a cartoon clipart chef, not emoji, no detailed eyes, no fancy chef uniform. 2 primary flat colours deep indigo #293C5A and warm saffron #D99C38, cream #FFF7E8 negative space/background. Broad thick lines and solid shapes. Symbol occupies 65% canvas. Beneath, modest original rounded sans lettering exact 'DUM E' with unmistakable spaces either side of E, then 'ODISHA' as substantial second line. No other text or tagline. Warm, confident, illustrative, clever, flat vector-like artwork. No gradients, shadows, texture, 3D, stock chef moustache, circle badge, mockup. Generous white space.
